title: Unit and integration testing with Wokwi and ESP-IDF Unity

spans.text: Split firmware into small testable units, such as a pure function that validates an ADC raw range. ESP-IDF Unity can test C/C++ components on target or on a host; keep test components separate from production firmware. Wokwi simulates boards, wiring, and sensors for GPIO/serial behavior, and its CLI can run repeatable simulation tests in CI.

Test scenarios: unit-test ADC boundaries `-1`, `0`, `4095`, and `4096`; simulate button and sensor inputs in Wokwi; integration-test timeout and recovery when an I2C device does not respond. Keep results in serial logs. Simulation does not fully reproduce real radio behavior, power use, analog noise, or JTAG.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: A unit test cannot validate physical pin voltage, radio range, or real sensor calibration. Isolate drivers with mocks/fakes, test timeouts and failure paths, then run hardware-in-the-loop checks on a real board. Avoid infinite waits and writes to production flash in tests.

visual_description: Add a wiring schematic and pin map showing board pins, VCC/GND, and signal direction; include a memory or task-state diagram where relevant.
